title: Distinct Interaction Mechanism of RNA Polymerase and ResD at Proximal and Distal Subsites for Transcription Activation of Nitrite Reductase in Bacillus subtilis.
authors: Jacob, Hannah; Geng, Hao; Shetty, Dasvit; Halow, Nathan; Kenney, Linda J; Nakano, Michiko M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究枯草芽孢杆菌中ResD转录因子与RNA聚合酶及DNA的互作机制，结合遗传分析和结构模拟揭示近端/远端亚位点的转录激活构型，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且含结构模拟，但非AI/深度学习或MD核心方法，深度有限。
abstract: The ResD-ResE signal transduction system plays a pivotal role in anaerobic nitrate respiration in Bacillus subtilis. The nasD operon encoding nitrite reductase is essential for nitrate respiration and is tightly controlled by the ResD response regulator. To understand the mechanism of ResD-dependent transcription activation of the nasD operon, we explored ResD-RNA polymerase (RNAP), ResD-DNA, and RNAP-DNA interactions required for nasD transcription. Full transcriptional activation requires the upstream promoter region where five molecules of ResD bind. The distal ResD-binding subsite at -87 to -84 partially overlaps a sequence similar to the consensus distal subsite of the upstream (UP) element with which the Escherichia coli C-terminal domain of the alpha subunit (alphaCTD) of RNAP interacts to stimulate transcription. We propose that interaction between alphaCTD and ResD at the promoter-distal site is essential for stimulating nasD transcription. Although nasD has an extended -10 promoter, it lacks a reasonable -35 element. Genetic analysis and structural simulations predicted that the absence of the -35 element might be compensated by interactions between sigma(A) and alphaCTD and between alphaCTD and ResD at the promoter-proximal ResD-binding subsite. Thus, our work suggested that ResD participates in nasD transcription activation by binding to two alphaCTD subunits at the proximal and distal promoter sites, representing a unique configuration for transcription activation. IMPORTANCE A significant number of ResD-controlled genes have been identified, and transcription regulatory pathways in which ResD participates have emerged. Nevertheless, the mechanism of how ResD activates transcription of different genes in a nucleotide sequence-specific manner has been less explored. This study suggested that among the five ResD-binding subsites in the promoter of the nasD operon, the promoter-proximal and -distal ResD-binding subsites play important roles in nasD activation by adapting different modes of protein-protein and protein-DNA interactions. The finding of a new type of protein-promoter architecture provides insight into the understanding of transcription activation mechanisms controlled by transcription factors, including the ubiquitous response regulators of two-component regulatory systems, particularly in Gram-positive bacteria.
abstract_zh: ResD-ResE信号转导系统在枯草芽孢杆菌的厌氧硝酸盐呼吸中发挥关键作用。编码亚硝酸盐还原酶的nasD操纵子对硝酸盐呼吸至关重要，并受ResD响应调节因子的严格调控。为理解ResD依赖性转录激活nasD操纵子的机制，我们探究了nasD转录所需的ResD-RNA聚合酶（RNAP）、ResD-DNA和RNAP-DNA相互作用。完全转录激活需要上游启动子区域，其中五个ResD分子结合。位于-87至-84的远端ResD结合亚位点部分重叠于与上游（UP）元件共有远端亚位点相似的序列，大肠杆菌RNAPα亚基的C端结构域（alphaCTD）与该元件相互作用以刺激转录。我们提出，alphaCTD与ResD在启动子远端位点的相互作用对刺激nasD转录至关重要。尽管nasD具有延伸的-10启动子，但缺乏合理的-35元件。遗传分析和结构模拟预测，-35元件的缺失可能通过sigma(A)与alphaCTD之间以及alphaCTD与ResD在启动子近端ResD结合亚位点的相互作用得到补偿。因此，我们的工作表明，ResD通过结合启动子近端和远端位点的两个alphaCTD亚基参与nasD转录激活，代表了一种独特的转录激活构型。重要性 已鉴定出大量ResD控制的基因，且ResD参与的转录调控途径已浮现。然而，ResD如何以核苷酸序列特异性方式激活不同基因转录的机制研究较少。本研究提示，在nasD操纵子启动子中的五个ResD结合亚位点中，启动子近端和远端的ResD结合亚位点通过采用不同的蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-DNA相互作用模式，在nasD激活中发挥重要作用。新型蛋白质-启动子结构的发现为理解转录因子（包括双组分调控系统中普遍存在的响应调节因子，尤其在革兰氏阳性菌中）控制的转录激活机制提供了见解。
